messages:
maya: quick question — we're seeing a lot of 413s + client retries from customers sending 1k+ short texts with crazy dims. thinking out loud: can we try soft-fallback routing to a cheaper 'embed-lite' variant instead of hard 413 for a canary? :thinking_face:

jordan: soft-fallback = route to smaller-dim model when preflight says dims>1024 or bytes>1MB? that could save pain but might change semantics a lot for some apps.

sasha: +1 on canary but we need strong telemetry. if we route to embed-lite we must tag the response with X-Embed-Fallback and log unit_delta, model_variant, and a sample of input hash for debugging.

liam: we already emit: 
```
X-Embed-Est-Units: 48
X-Embed-Bytes: 12034
X-Embed-Dims: 1536
```
from preflight. adding X-Embed-Fallback: embed-lite should be trivial. runtime already has model aliasing.

maya: cool — UX asks for console signals: show per-route fallback_rate, avg_token_units_saved, and a list of sample query_ids (masked). product wants a toggle to opt-in per-tenant.

ana: (cc @ana) minor spelling: ana is me :) but yes — two questions: 1) how do we estimate quality loss? 2) how do we bill units when fallback triggers? do we charge cheaper unit rate?

ana: answer to 2) Billing should reflect actual model used. So if fallback->embed-lite we bill embed-lite rates. but we must show a pre/post cost estimate in console so customers know the delta.

jordan: for quality loss we can instrument a tiny eval: sample 0.5% of fallback requests, run upstream model offline and compute cosine(sim) between vectors or reranker score delta. store mean+95p per-route. call it "fallback_regression".

sasha: that offline comparison needs to be privacy-safe — only hashed inputs and vectors, no PII. ops: can we store that in telemetry bucket labeled "emb_fallback_eval" for 90 days?

liam: yes, retention 90d ok. cost back-of-envelope says extra compute for sampled eval ~ 0.02% of cost.

maya: rollout plan suggestion:
1) server-side opt-in flag (tenant level) behind feature flag
2) 1% tenant canary for 24h, monitor fallback_regression, fallback_rate, retry_rate, avg_latency, and units_saved
3) if regression>0.12 or retry_rate increases, automatic rollback

jordan: + add console alerting rule template: warn when fallback_rate>0.5% AND fallback_regression>0.05 OR retry_rate_up_by>10% over baseline.

ana: telemetry change request (proto): add fields to preflight response and request logs: 
```
preflight: {
  client_id: string,
  est_units: int,
  input_dims: int,
  input_bytes: int,
  suggested_variant: string (nullable)
}
```
We should also add runtime decision event: fallback_decision: {chosen_variant, reason, sampled_for_eval:boolean}

maya: console UX — show per-route toggle "Enable embed-lite fallback" with a link to preflight suggestions and cost delta estimate. when users hover show: "May change embedding fidelity — we sample and show regression metrics."

sasha: edgecases: mixed-dims batch requests — some items fine, some oversize. runtime should try per-item fallback (split) instead of entire batch fallback. we need to decide on atomicity. would be major runtime change.

liam: practical approach: for mixed batches, do per-item fallback when possible, else fall back whole-batch if batch-level affinities prevent split. we'll emit event: batch_split_attempted:true/false.

maya: ok, one more ask: canary-bot, kick a canary with these flags for tenant sample 'canary-embed-lite-1' starting now?

canary-bot: canary 'canary-embed-lite-1' created for 1% of tenants. feature_flag=embed_lite_fallback, sampling=1%, watchlist=[emb_fallback_eval, fallback_rate, retry_rate, units_saved].

jordan: runtime note: we should avoid adding a new header to public API without versioning. prefer `X-Redwood-Embed-Est-Units` for backwards compat. clients won't break. misc: also include `X-Redwood-Embed-Fallback: embed-lite` when used.

ana: logging schema update filed: ENGPLAT-1429. added owners: sasha, liam. pls add console tile mock for product review.

maya: timeline: implement telemetry + headers this week, runtime routing change + sampling next week, console tile after metrics land. target: 2-week canary.

liam: quick runtime snippet (pseudo):
```
if preflight.est_units > tenant.soft_quota_threshold:
  if tenant.allow_embed_lite:
    choose_variant('embed-lite')
    emit_event('fallback_decision', {chosen:'embed-lite', reason:'units_over_threshold'})
  else:
    return 413
```
Keep it simple for the canary.

sasha: test plan: unit tests for header parsing, integration test that verifies fallback header present, e2e that compares sampled offline vectors. Also add chaos test for retry storms.

maya: thanks team. i'll create the console mock and link to ENGPLAT-1429. followups: jordan to wire alert template, liam/sasha runtime + telemetry, ana to confirm billing mapping with finance. :) :thumbsup:

jordan: acked. starting alert template now.

liam: on it. will push a small change to preflight header naming and runtime event emitter.

canary-bot: canary 'canary-embed-lite-1' rollout: 1% tenants, started at 1748882348. monitoring dashboards created: eng.platform/embeds/fallbacks-canary-1748882348

maya: nice. ping me if metrics look off.
